mechanism_narrative: The persistent decline in transit station mobility from +0.9 to -21.3 over three weeks indicates a collapse in trips to commercial districts; continued transit suppression will keep retail-and-recreation footfall below its last-28-day mean over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT at t-0w is -21.3 and at t-3w is +0.9
failure_condition: If TRANSIT remains below -20 for two consecutive weeks but the next-28-day mean of RETAIL_REC is not lower than its last-28-day mean, reject.

mechanism_narrative: When workplace mobility crosses below -10 percent, work-from-home and reduced commuting cut lunchtime and after-work retail spending, pushing RETAIL_REC lower over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES weekly mean falls below -10 percent (observed -16.9 at t-0w)
failure_condition: If WORKPLACES remains below -10 for two weeks but the next-14-day mean of RETAIL_REC is higher than its prior-14-day mean, reject.

mechanism_narrative: The joint collapse in transit and workplace mobility reduces both commute and office footfall, creating a multiplicative drag on retail-and-recreation that persists four weeks.
failure_condition: If both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES remain below their t-0w levels but the next-28-day mean of RETAIL_REC is not lower than its last-28-day mean, reject.

mechanism_narrative: In a tightening-restrictions regime, a residential mobility increase above +5 combined with workplace decline below -10 signals at-home confinement; this suppresses discretionary retail and recreation trips for at least two weeks.
failure_condition: If RESIDENTIAL > +5 and WORKPLACES < -10 but the next-14-day mean of RETAIL_REC is higher than its prior-14-day mean, reject.

mechanism_narrative: A drop in grocery-and-pharmacy mobility below -10 indicates households are cutting all non-essential trips, including retail-and-recreation, so RETAIL_REC falls over the next week.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM weekly mean falls below -10 percent (observed -13.4 at t-0w)
failure_condition: If GROCERY_PHARM stays below -10 but the next-7-day mean of RETAIL_REC is not lower than its prior-7-day mean, reject.

mechanism_narrative: When parks mobility crosses below -10, it confirms broad withdrawal from outdoor discretionary activity, which precedes a two-week decline in retail-and-recreation mobility.
candidate_trigger: PARKS weekly mean falls below -10 percent (observed -11.1 at t-0w)
failure_condition: If PARKS remains below -10 but the next-14-day mean of RETAIL_REC is not lower than its prior-14-day mean, reject.

mechanism_narrative: A residential mobility increase above +5 signals stay-at-home orders or voluntary confinement, which directly removes retail-and-recreation trips and lowers RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: If RESIDENTIAL remains above +5 but the next-14-day mean of RETAIL_REC is not lower than its prior-14-day mean, reject.

mechanism_narrative: The simultaneous breach of RETAIL_REC below -15, TRANSIT below -20, and WORKPLACES below -15 marks a synchronized mobility contraction; the interaction among these series predicts continued retail-and-recreation weakness over four weeks.
failure_condition: If all three thresholds are met but the next-28-day mean of RETAIL_REC is not lower than its last-28-day mean, reject.
